name: Coffee machine production line solution
summary: A complete line automation solution for coffee machine manufacturers, covering heating component assembly, water pump installation, and final testing and packaging.
contentHtml:
The coffee machine production line solution is a complete line automation solution provided by TXAM for coffee machine manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers heating component assembly, water pump installation, water circuit sealing, temperature control system installation, appearance treatment, functional testing, air tightness testing, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Precision assembly of heating components ensures heating efficiency
  • Automated water pump installation ensures precise and reliable positioning
  • Water circuit sealing system ensures no leakage
  • High temperature control accuracy with good temperature consistency
  • Comprehensive functional testing ensures product quality
  • Automated appearance treatment ensures high consistency

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
